frontmatter.summary: Group bookings is asked for a third time through sales, as a line in a contract, not as a problem a restaurant has had

input.body:
Nordic Steak wants group bookings in the contract before they sign. The ask reached me through sales as a contract line, not as a problem a restaurant has had. That is the third time, after June and the steering on 2026-07-09, and the shape is the same ([[people/marcus-ek]], [[customers/nordic-steak]], [[research/group-bookings]]). The answer has not moved: group bookings waits on the deposits work, so Q1 2027 ([[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]]). The same message asks for the Google button as if it were coming. It has been live since 2026-05-12, and sales was not told ([[tickets/jira/GST-77]]).

Marcus Ek, in #sales at 08:52 on 2026-07-17, wants an answer this week: "Their ops lead needs two things in the contract: group bookings with a set menu, and the Google "Book a table" button on every restaurant. Can I tell them both are coming this autumn? I NEED BOTH TO SIGN THEM."
input.rationale: The record of what was asked, so the next group bookings question from sales lands on it instead of starting over.

input.append: - 2026-07-17: told through Marcus: the Google button is live now, switched on under Settings, Booking channels ([[tickets/jira/GST-77]]); group bookings is Q1 2027, after deposits ([[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]]).
input.rationale: The ledger's last line is "on the roadmap" with no quarter. Today Marcus gets a date for the button and a quarter for group bookings, and this is what Oskar hears.

input.append: - 2026-07-17: the Google button has been live since 2026-05-12 ([[tickets/jira/GST-77]]), so it goes in the Nordic Steak contract as done; group bookings is Q1 2027 and the date is not open ([[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]]).
input.rationale: The reply to Marcus is drafted today. It gives him the date for the button and the quarter for group bookings, so his page says so.

variants.label: One message to forward
variants.body:
Live since 2026-05-12: the Book a table button on Google, for every restaurant. Each restaurant switches it on under Settings, Booking channels. That one goes in the contract as done.

Q1 2027: group bookings, parties over eight with a set menu and a deposit. It needs deposits at booking first, and those come in Q4. There is no earlier date.

What Nordic Steak can put in the contract now: the Google button, live today; one text reminder per booking, the day before at 17:00; table areas, live since 2026-07-14. A month inside Q1 2027 for group bookings is not one of them.

text: One yes and one no. The yes shipped on 2026-05-12 and sales was not told ([[tickets/jira/GST-77]]). The no was decided on 2026-06-18, and nothing since has changed it: steering on 2026-07-09 took no decisions ([[decisions/2026-06-18-group-bookings-after-deposits]], [[meetings/2026-07-09-steering]]).

On the record: the third ask as an insight, so the next one lands on it, and what Nordic Steak and Marcus are told today ([[customers/nordic-steak]], [[people/marcus-ek]]). Nothing waits for approval. Nothing was sent: the reply is above in the sales voice, copy the tab you want and send it yourself.
